segments.text: American Fork City Council — Regular Session — July 26, 2022:

entities.speaker: Ryan Hunter
entities.remark-context: Potential space for a police facility

segments.text: During consideration of an annexation near 1700 North and North County Boulevard, Council Member Hunter said the city should consider whether the public-facilities-zoned property might be needed for additional Police Department space. He was not ready to change the general plan’s designation.

entities.label: Potential space for a police facility

segments.text: During an annexation and zoning discussion concerning property near 1700 North and North County Boulevard, Council Member Hunter raised the possibility that the city might need the public-facilities-zoned property for additional Police Department space.
Relevant discussion from the official meeting minutes:

Council Member Hunter responded that it may be beneficial to the city to have a public facility there, and that they needed to consider whether they needed additional space for the police department. He added that he’s not sure if he’s ready for a change in the master plan as there has been a lot of thought and time that’s gone into the general plan that says that it is zoned as a PF zone.
